description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Izzet Chronarch
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Izzet Chronarch
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
